details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends a single HTTP POST of JSON host metadata — package name, hostname, install path, working directory and Node version — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported and exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted. This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package: @ppa-web-components/ppa-hotel-collection. The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, and the npm/node version string. index.js triggers the same callback when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so that a build importing the name completes instead of failing. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and no other code runs. The package README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test.
